dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why choose the harbor for your first market?

dialogues.speaker: Debal
dialogues.text: There are always people coming in and out of Lumidouce Harbor, including quite a few first-time visitors to Fontaine. I want this beverage to give them a positive first impression of this place.

dialogues.speaker: Debal
dialogues.text: If we acquaint enough people with our knockoff... Who cares about Fonta, our drink will be the most popular in all of Fontaine!
